name: kanso-export-html
description: Export a note as one self-contained HTML page, as Kanso's "Export as web page" does. TeX math ($…$ and $$…$$), Mermaid diagrams and Excalidraw drawings are drawn as inline SVG, attached images are embedded as data URIs, and the page has no scripts and loads nothing from the network. Returns the HTML.

noteId.description: ID of the note to export. It can be found as `_id` in the note docs. It always starts with `note:`.

theme.description: The colors of the page: Kanso's light (paper) or dark (graphite) theme.

name: kanso-get-outline
description: Retrieve a note's outline: its headings in order, each with its level (1 to 6), its text without Markdown markers, and the 0-based line it is on in the note's body. Headings inside code blocks are not part of the outline.

noteId.description: ID of the note. It can be found as `_id` in the note docs. It always starts with `note:`.

name: kanso-resolve-wikilink
description: Find the note a wiki-link points at. Accepts `[[Title]]`, `[[Title#Heading]]` or `[[Title|alias]]`, with or without the brackets. Titles match without regard to case or extra spaces, among notes outside the trash; when several notes share a title, the one created first is the match. Returns the note's ID, title and `inkdrop://note/<id>` link, which is the form to write when linking to it, plus the heading's line when the link names a heading the note has.

link.description: The wiki-link, such as `[[Project Plan#Budget]]`, or just the title.
